title: רב חגא

paragraphs: Rav Chaga, Rav Huna’s student. He brought Huna into Chiyya’s cave (see his entry), never saw a seminal emission, and at 18 learned the whole Talmud from Huna. He was 80 at Huna’s burial, and 80 years were added to him. See Jerusalem Talmud, Kilayim 9:4, and Midrash Kohelet, on “Whatever your hand finds to do,”for how he buried him.
